import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set a clean aesthetic style for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between megapixels, price, and sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    alpha=0.7,  # Use transparency to show density in overlapping areas
    s=100,      # Set a fixed size for markers for better readability
    palette='viridis' # A perceptually uniform color palette, good for categorical data
)

# Add a title and labels for clarity
plt.title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)

# Position the legend outside the plot area to prevent overlap with data points
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# Ensure all elements fit within the figure area, especially with the legend outside
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set a clean aesthetic style for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between megapixels, price, and sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    alpha=0.7,  # Use transparency to show density in overlapping areas
    s=100,      # Set a fixed size for markers for better readability
    palette='viridis' # A perceptually uniform color palette, good for categorical data
)

# Add a title and labels for clarity
plt.title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)

# Position the legend outside the plot area to prevent overlap with data points
